Noah: Quick alert — ~12 onboarding tenants seeing partial search results after an embeddings rollout. Need a short external status and a tailored note for 2 high-touch accounts. cc @Priya @Lina :warning:

Priya: Can you confirm if any data was lost? I can draft the public note.

Lina: Tech TL;DR: deploy caused a timing regression in embed workers; some backfill shards stalled and retried. Patch rolled at 02:10, backfill restarted at 02:25. No data lost; read completeness is affected until backfill finishes (~45% current).

Sam: Recommend simple two-step comms: batch heads-up + personalized outreach for high-touch with credits and optional troubleshooting.

Noah: Draft batch status (short):

Hi <Customer>,

Were contacting to let you know a subset of onboarding customers may see incomplete search results while an index backfill completes. We deployed a fix and backfills are running (~45% complete). Expected finish 3-5 hours.

What were doing: prioritizing your backfill, monitoring, and applying safe throttles.
Compensation: 1-day usage credit; high-touch accounts offered an additional 2-day credit and a 30-min troubleshooting session.

Reply if youd like a dedicated update or to schedule a session.

Thanks, Noah (Customer Success)

Priya: Small logs for transparency:
[kubelet] eviction: memory.available < threshold
pod embed-worker-9a restarted, shard requeued
backfill progress: 21/48 shards reconciled

OncallBot: Incident INC-2026-2201 updated  severity=MEDIUM at 6187654338.

Noah: Outreach plan: send batch heads-up in 20m. High-touch: StellarEdu, BrightFoundry. Lina to post backfill % updates and final RCA when complete. Sam to flag renewals <60d.

Sam: StellarEdu renewal in 32 days  flagging for AE handoff. BrightFoundry >90d. Sheet link will be posted.

Lina: Backfill now at 68% after increasing safe concurrency. Will announce at 100%.

Noah: Action items:
- Sam: paste tenant list + renewal flags into the incident doc (by +15m)
- Priya: prep personalized drafts for high-touch (by +40m)
- Lina: post completion and final RCA when done
- Noah: queue batch send after review

OncallBot: Next update scheduled in 40 minutes.

Noah: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source for customer comms edits and final sends.
